name: d20-folio
description: d20 Folio — a free, bilingual (EN+IT), offline-first PWA for D&D 2024 players: character creation, play cockpit, campaigns. Built on the CC-BY SRD 5.2.1.

paragraphs: A free, bilingual (English + Italian) PWA for D&D 2024 players to create, level up, play, and manage characters and campaigns. Offline-first, with the complete 2024 SRD pre-loaded and every rule auto-computed.
features: Complete D&D 2024 SRD, pre-loaded. Classes and subclasses, spells, feats, species, backgrounds, equipment (weapons, armor, gear), magic items, and conditions ship as static TypeScript data and are referenced by srdId,…

Rules engine that automates mechanics, override-first. Every mechanic-bearing fact is a typed Grant on the SRD data. evaluateGrants aggregates them and drives derived stats (AC, proficiency bonus, spell save DC, attack…
SRD-aware creation and level-up wizards. The wizards suggest features, spells, and ability increases for you, applying 2024 rules correctly (background-based ASI, current 2024 species rules).

Character cockpit with play and edit modes. Inline editing in place (no detours to sub-pages), plus an immediate-commit combat model with a cost engine, condition gating, and rich in-combat casting (upcast, free-cast,…
Campaigns and party play. A campaign hub with shareable invite/join links, party view, DM tools, a shared treasury, shared notes, sessions, and a markdown Chronicle with chapters and version history.

whatItDoes.text: A free, bilingual (English + Italian) PWA for D&D 2024 players to create, level up, play, and manage characters and campaigns. Offline-first, with the complete 2024 SRD pre-loaded and every rule auto-computed.

requirements.text: It requires a free Google sign-in (Google is the only auth provider); your characters are private to your account.
Every route except the landing and login is code-split with React.lazy.
